# Copilot instructions

Read and follow the repository root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before proposing or changing code. It is the canonical project instruction.

Role and boundary contracts live in `.agents/skills/{name}/SKILL.md`. Each one's frontmatter `description` says when it applies and where to go instead; read the ones your change actually matches, and their `references/` only when you hit what they describe. This runtime does not auto-invoke them — open the files.
